seo_desc: Lino Lakes has a Saturday Breakfast with Santa hosted by police and fire, and nearby Hugo holds a Santa Party with a tree lighting.
lede: Lino Lakes has a Saturday Breakfast with Santa hosted by police and fire, and nearby Hugo holds a Santa Party with a tree lighting.
celebrates: Lino Lakes starts its season the Saturday after Thanksgiving, when the Public Safety Department hosts its annual Breakfast with Santa on Birch Street. Hugo, just north, holds a Santa Party on a December weeknight at the Peder Pedersen Pavilion in Lions Park, and the mayor lights the holiday tree at 6:30 pm, according to the city. Both cities list the events on their own calendars.
lastyear: The Lino Lakes Public Safety Department calls its Breakfast with Santa annual, so the November event repeats each year. Hugo's calendar also describes its Santa Party as an annual event. We did not find 2025 recaps from either city, so this page lists 2026 dates only.
facts: Hugo's Santa Party sits in the Peder Pedersen Pavilion inside Lions Park. Hugo city hall is at 14669 Fitzgerald Avenue North. Lino Lakes holds its breakfast at 1710 Birch St.
trains: Lino Lakes has no train ride of its own that we could verify. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm, in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm and at Saint Paul Union Depot on December 13 at 7 pm, with free concerts, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum runs Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides at the Jackson Street Roundhouse, 193 Pennsylvania Ave E in Saint Paul, with pictures with Santa on the North Pole Mail Train, caboose rides, crafts and story time from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the museum.

With an annual Breakfast with Santa hosted by the Public Safety Department the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
Where is the Lino Lakes Breakfast with Santa?
1710 Birch St, Lino Lakes, on November 28 from 8:30 to 11 am.
What is the Hugo Santa Party?
A Santa party at the Peder Pedersen Pavilion on December 9 from 5 to 7 pm, with a 6:30 pm tree lighting.
